name: Presence (spirit power)
description: Constant spirit power granting awareness of everything within a chosen domain, making the spirit coterminous with its landscape feature; possessed by all genii loci and many ghosts.

name: Regio (spirit power)
description: Ritual spirit power, usable only by spirits with Presence, that forms a Magic regio layer in the spirit's landscape; Might spent is permanently lost.

name: Stasis
description: Ritual-like spirit power that closes off a Magic-aura area so that residents' aging points become Warping points instead.

name: Eidolon (power)
description: Common spirit power used to create illusions and communicate, e.g. an oasis illusion or phantom noises.

name: Master of (Form)
description: Spirit power duplicating non-Ritual Muto or Perdo spells of a Form at a Might cost, e.g. Master of Water, Master of Earth, Master of Plants.

name: Master of Sound
description: Power of the Zwergenstimme imago duplicating any non-Ritual sound spell up to level 15.

name: Bring Down the Roof
description: Zwergenstimme power that collapses a cave roof, causing +20 damage and sealing the exit.

name: Ghost Touch
description: Spirit power letting the Zwergenstimme hurl rocks at enemies at a Might cost per attack.

name: Gift of Self Assurance
description: Power of the Spirit of Self-Importance that donates a Confidence point to an action that makes its target seem more competent.

name: The Preening Peacock
description: Power raising a touched target's Presence above that of his companions until he looks foolish.

name: Donning the Corporeal Veil
description: Common spirit power allowing a spirit or ghost to manifest in material form.

name: Guide
description: Common spirit power (Mentem) possessed by many genii loci and Astra Planeta.

name: Manifestation
description: Spirit power by which a genius loci manifests through creatures, e.g. Adranus possessing Sicilian eagles.

name: Material Anchor
description: Spirit power used to mark prey and intentionally form Arcane Connections; used by the Erinnyes.

name: Sight Beyond Sight
description: Typical power of the Astra Planeta and the Leti.

name: Touch of Death
description: Leti power acting as Clenching Grasp of the Crushed Heart at Touch range, costing 6 Might.

name: Crafter of (Form)
description: Spirit power duplicating non-Ritual Creo or Rego spells of a Form, e.g. Crafter of Fire, Earth, or Water.

name: Ruler of (Form)
description: Spirit power duplicating spells pertaining to a specific substance, e.g. Ruler of Lava, Smoke, Sandstorms, or Fog.

name: Hibernation
description: Ritual power of Adranus letting the spirit stay inactive for a year and save Might for its awakening.

name: Grant (Virtue)
description: Spirit power granting Virtues to chosen humans, e.g. Grant Dowsing, Grant Puissance in (Ability).

name: Grant (Flaw)
description: Spirit power inflicting Flaws such as Visions, Wrathful, Greater Malediction, or No Sense of Direction.

name: Oath-Swearing
description: Genius loci power used to enforce bargains and pacts.

name: Control Human
description: Typical spirit power of eidolons, lugra, and some genii loci.

name: Healing (spirit power)
description: Ritual spirit power of healing possessed by al-Meraya and Aillwee.

name: Riding the Phantom Steed
description: Sir Giles' power to materialize his war horse when he takes physical form.

name: Invisibility (Sir Giles)
description: Sir Giles' power to make himself and his horse invisible except to Second Sight.

name: Ride in Dreams
description: Sir Giles' power to enter the dreams of a named sleeper and torment him with nightmares.

name: Tether Strength
description: Value tied to spirit Might used in the Formation of Magic Auras.

name: Magic Aura
description: Supernatural aura of the Magic Realm, in which Airy Spirits swarm and Things of Virtue are found.

name: Regio
description: Supernatural layered region with increasing aura; spirits can create and control regio layers.

name: Might
description: Measure of a supernatural creature's power; spells to summon or control spirits must penetrate it.

name: Vis
description: Physical embodiment of raw magical power, lifeblood and currency of the Order of Hermes.

name: Warping
description: Magical corruption accumulated from magic; aging under Stasis converts to Warping points and Enriched Things of Virtue confer it.

name: Wizard's Twilight
description: State magi may enter from Warping, e.g. from double-botched dedicated vis study.

name: Final Twilight
description: The end state of a magus' Twilight feared by Schwall.

name: Twilight Scars
description: Marks gained from Twilight episodes.

name: Decrepitude
description: Aging measure; under Stasis aging crises instead add Warping.

name: Aspect
description: Independent agent a Daimon creates to act on Earth; it is a constant Arcane Connection to its Daimon.

name: True Name
description: Secret name expressing a being's spiritual essence; an indefinite Arcane Connection learned as a spell-like ability.

name: Synthemata
description: Signs, symbols, or passwords linking a magician to a supernatural creature, used in theurgic spells.

name: Arcane Connection
description: Link used to target or summon; for Airy Spirits any worldly representation serves.

name: Apotheosis
description: Process by which an animus or other being is elevated to a Daimon.

name: Titanomachia
description: War of the Titans in which Faerie gods ousted the Magic spirits from the thrones of the world.

name: Confidence Score
description: Trait possessed by all Daimons (at least 1) and some spirits.

name: Magical Qualities and Inferiorities
description: Build options for magical creatures such as Focus Power, Ritual Power, and Reduced Abilities.

name: Focus Power
description: Magical Quality granting a flexible spirit power such as Master of (Form).

name: Ritual Power
description: Magical Quality for powers with ritual-like effect, e.g. Regio and Hibernation.

name: Greater Power
description: Virtue/Magical Quality granting a designed supernatural power.

name: Lesser Power
description: Virtue/Magical Quality granting a lesser supernatural power.

name: Extraordinary Vis
description: Vis from places of great power that emulates a magical device or replicates a spell.

name: Lesser Enchantment Vis
description: Extraordinary vis emulating a lesser enchantment, usually level 30 or lower, not consumed by use.

name: Spell-like Vis
description: Extraordinary vis mimicking a high-level spell, consumed at the end of the effect.

name: Dedicated Vis
description: Rare vis tied to a Technique and Form combination, counting double for spells, study, and enchantment.

name: Vis Storage
description: Optional rule: large vis stocks of one Art cause spontaneous Art-appropriate spells nearby.

name: Insubstantial Vis
description: Vis in forms like breezes, sound, or light requiring special containers.

name: Things of Virtue
description: Herbs and Objects of Virtue infused with Magic that can be Enriched to grant Virtues.

name: Herbs of Virtue
description: Magically infused plants that lose potency over time but often confer a Major Virtue.

name: Objects of Virtue
description: Magically infused items, such as parts of Beasts of Virtue or gemstones, that confer Minor Virtues.

name: Enrichment
description: Season-long procedure using Magic Lore to activate a Thing of Virtue's hidden powers.

name: Shape and Material Bonus
description: Enchantment bonuses from objects resonating with the Magic realm; doubled by dedicated vis.

name: Purgatory
description: Western Church antechamber to Heaven from which ghosts often claim to come.

name: Hermetic Spirit Magic
description: Mystery allowing magi to use an Airy Spirit's Might to maintain spells or empower enchantments.

name: Hermetic Theurgy
description: Mystery allowing magi to invent Daimon-summoning spells without texts and use synthemata.

name: Goetic Arts
description: Non-Hermetic arts (Summoning, Ablating, Binding, Commanding) for controlling spirits; Major Supernatural Virtues advanced as Arts.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic magic resistance ritual.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance that prevents benefiting from Enriched Things of Virtue.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Hermetic ward that suppresses the powers of Things of Virtue.

name: Talisman
description: Magus' bonded item; an Enriched Thing of Virtue made into one ignores its owner's Magic Resistance.

name: Laboratory Text
description: Record needed by non-theurgists to invent a Daimon-summoning ritual.

name: Limit of the Lunar Sphere
description: Boundary between the material world and celestial bodies bridged by the Astra Planeta.

name: Sphere of Mentem
description: Part of the Magic Realm where visitors may leave behind eidolons.

name: Animus
description: Spirit that may function within beings; may become a Daimon through apotheosis.

name: Ritual (spell)
description: Ritual spells and effects, e.g. Daimon-summoning Rego Vim rituals.

name: Airy Spirits
description: Spirits native to the material world, swarming in Magic auras and often unnoticed.

name: Daimons
description: Named Spirits with the Daimon Virtue who dwell in the Magic Realm and send Aspects to earth.

name: Florae
description: Airy Spirits attending plants, appearing female with vegetative features; also called nymphae.

name: Fauni
description: Airy Spirits attending creatures, appearing as male animals or hybrids; sometimes called satyroi.

name: The Flora of a Bulrush
description: Might 5 Herbam spirit appearing as a young girl paddling in a stream.

name: Spirits of the Elements
description: Airy Spirits representing individual non-living objects in natural form.

name: Elementals
description: Animated pure substances, often confused with spirits of the elements.

name: Imagines
description: Spirits of sensation embodying sensory species (singular imago).

name: Zwergenstimme Imago
description: Echo spirit ("dwarf voice") haunting caves and misleading lost humans.

name: Eidolons
description: Airy Spirits of emotions created by humans near strong magic.

name: The Spirit of Self-Importance
description: Might 10 Mentem eidolon that looks like its owner's idealized self.

name: Genii Loci
description: Spirits of place inhabiting natural features via the Presence power.

name: Okeanides
description: Greek genii loci of the seas.

name: Potamoi
description: Greek genii loci of the rivers.

name: Oreades
description: Greek genii loci of hills and mountains.

name: Dryades
description: Greek genii loci of forests.

name: Anemoi
description: Greek spirits of specific winds.

name: Landwichten
description: German name for genii loci; Land-wights; Norse Landvaettir.

name: Jinn
description: Genii loci of Persia, the Holy Land, North Africa, and Iberia, aligned to Magic, Faerie, or Infernal; bound by bargains.

name: Lugra
description: Spirits of the hardships of life, released from Pandora's jar.

name: Theoi
description: Informal title for the most powerful Daimons, e.g. Helios, Prometheus, Pallas.

name: Astra Planeta
description: The seven planetary spirits linking the celestial spheres to the Realm of Magic.

name: Selene
description: Planetary spirit of the moon, ruling commoners, fertility, rainfall and witchcraft.

name: Helios
description: Planetary spirit of the sun and one of the Theoi, ruling royalty and healing.

name: Stilbon
description: Planetary spirit of Mercury, ruling knowledge, scribes and travelers.

name: Eosophoros
description: Planetary spirit of Venus, ruling romance, poets and jewels.

name: Pyroeis
description: Planetary spirit of Mars, ruling war, fire and monsters.

name: Phaethon
description: Planetary spirit of Jupiter, ruling clergy, law and science.

name: Phainon
description: Planetary spirit of Saturn, ruling death, secrecy and sorrow.

name: Leti
description: Daimons of death, in varieties each led by an eponymous leader.

name: Keres
description: Leti of violent death, led by Ker.

name: Thanatoi
description: Leti of peaceful death, led by Thanatos.

name: Akylides
description: Leti of poison and disease, led by Akhlys.

name: Moroi
description: Leti leading the doomed to fated demise, led by Moros.

name: Erinnyes
description: Chthonic Leti who avenge crimes against the natural and moral order.

name: Teletarch
description: Master of Perfection: powerful Daimon embodying a concept or phenomenon.

name: Protogonoi
description: Most primeval spirits, echoes of the Words of Creation; never summoned.

name: Kosmokrators
description: Governors of the Magic Realm, once walking the earth as Titans, Jotnar, and Fomoire.

name: Titans
description: Greek name for the Kosmokrators, bound in the underworld by Zeus.

name: Jotnar
description: Norse giants identified with Kosmokrators, slain by Odin and his brothers.

name: Fomoire
description: Celtic beings driven beyond the Ninth Wave by the Children of Danu.

name: Ghosts
description: Spirits of dead humans tied to the world by emotion or need; must have Magic Spirit Virtue.

name: Apparitions
description: Lucid ghosts claiming to return from the afterlife, seeking help to pass on.

name: Shades
description: Ghosts that are distorted reflections dominated by an emotional tie.

name: Spectres
description: Ghosts doggedly continuing their roles in life, e.g. Tremere's ghostly soldiers.

name: Ghostly Warder
description: Shade with an emotional connection to watch over a character.

name: Adranus
description: Might 50 Ignem Daimon slumbering beneath Mount Etna, once worshiped as a fire god.

name: Rhenus
description: Might 50 Aquam spirit of the Rhine pinioned at the Rhinefalls.

name: al-Meraya (spirit)
description: Might 40 Terram Daimon of a thirsty, expanding desert in southern Iberia.

name: Brienz
description: Might 30 Aquam Daimon of Lake Brienz, reclusive and irritated by fish.

name: Aillwee
description: Might 20 Terram spirit of Aillwee Cave that hungers for shiny things.

name: Salamander of Virtue
description: Magical beast associated with Ignem.

name: Beasts of Virtue
description: Magical animals whose corpses may yield Objects of Virtue, e.g. Snake or Lion of Virtue.

name: Ledea
description: Merinita maga who started a healing cult around an Airy Spirit's spring, hoping to convert it to Faerie.

name: Porphyrion
description: Magus of House Tytalus claiming to have found Pandora's jar beneath the Senate in Rome.

name: Schwall
description: Reclusive Aquam magus, formerly of Rheinstein, who befriended the Rhine spirit.

name: Maria
description: Young woman near Mount Etna with the Visions Flaw who predicts eruptions.

name: Ismail
description: Ancient hermit of the desert of al-Meraya who communes with its spirit.

name: Wecelo
description: Expert fisherman of Lake Brienz saved from drowning by the lake spirit.

name: Ciaran
description: Feral boy adopted by the Aillwee Cave spirit, stealing on its behalf.

name: Sir Giles
description: Ghostly knight, a Magical apparition in black mail, haunted by pride.

name: Charles IV
description: Holy Roman Emperor who wrote of a haunting at his castle in Prague.

name: Snowball
description: Yorkshire tailor attacked by a shapechanging ghost.

name: Theitmar of Merseburg
description: Bishop quoted on the night being given to the dead.

name: Hesiod
description: Greek poet whose Theogony lists the children of Eris.

name: Pandora
description: Mythic woman who opened the jar releasing the lugra.

name: Eris
description: Strife, mother of the lugra per Hesiod.

name: Elpis
description: Hope, the only being remaining in Pandora's jar.

name: Horkos
description: Oath, a child of Eris most damaging to men who swear falsely.

name: Mithras
description: Roman warrior god some Flambeau magi consider a Theos of honor and loyalty.

name: Prometheus
description: Minor Greek mythic figure among the Theoi.

name: Pallas
description: Minor Greek mythic figure among the Theoi.

name: Zeus
description: Faerie god who bound the Titans in the underworld.

name: Odin
description: Faerie god who formed the world from the slain Jotnar.

name: Vulcan
description: Roman god of fire who cast out Adranus.

name: Adam
description: First man whose curse some Christian magi say created the lugra.

name: Ker
description: Leader of the Keres.

name: Thanatos
description: Leader of the Thanatoi.

name: Akhlys
description: Leader of the Akylides.

name: Moros
description: Leader of the Moroi.

name: Children of Danu
description: Celtic gods who drove the Fomoire beyond the Ninth Wave.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The Order of magi for whom vis is lifeblood and currency.

name: Moors
description: Muslim inhabitants of southern Iberia near al-Meraya.

name: Western Church
description: Church that accepts the concept of Purgatory.

name: House Merinita
description: Hermetic House of Ledea.

name: House Tytalus
description: Hermetic House of Porphyrion.

name: House Flambeau
description: Hermetic House some of whose magi consider Mithras a Theos.

name: House Criamon
description: Hermetic House whose domus magna is the Cave of Twisting Shadows.

name: House Tremere
description: Hermetic House with an army of ghostly soldiers (spectres).

name: Rhine Tribunal
description: Tribunal detailed in Guardians of the Forests, with many forest genii loci.

name: Rheinstein
description: Destroyed Rhine covenant to which Schwall formerly belonged.

name: Mount Etna
description: Volcano on Sicily, home of Adranus; last erupted 1194.

name: Sicily
description: Mediterranean island where Mount Etna stands.

name: Rhinefalls
description: Waterfall on the upper Rhine where the river spirit is pinioned.

name: Rhine
description: One of Europe's great rivers, with a genius loci Rhenus.

name: Black Forest
description: Forest north of the Rhinefalls.

name: Desert of al-Meraya
description: Desert north of al-Meraya in southeast Iberia, inhabited by a thirsty spirit.

name: al-Meraya
description: Moorish port city (Almeria) in southeast Iberia.

name: Iberia
description: Region including the desert of al-Meraya; home of jinn.

name: Lake Brienz
description: Steep-sided Alpine lake fed by the Aare.

name: River Aare
description: River feeding Lake Brienz.

name: Alps
description: Mountains containing Lake Brienz and the Cave of Twisting Shadows.

name: Aillwee Cave
description: Cave system beneath the Burren in Hibernia, home of a spirit.

name: An Bhoireann
description: Rocky wilderness in western Hibernia above Aillwee Cave.

name: Hibernia
description: Region where Aillwee Cave lies.

name: Cave of Twisting Shadows
description: Domus magna of House Criamon in the Alps, with a powerful cave genius loci.

name: Mount Olympus
description: Where the kind counterparts to the lugra were summoned by the Gods.

name: Eden
description: From which Adam was cast.

name: Rome
description: City where Porphyrion claims to have found Pandora's jar beneath the Senate.

name: Paris
description: Where Porphyrion was last spotted.

name: Prague
description: Site of Charles IV's haunted castle.

name: Yorkshire
description: English region of medieval ghost tales.

name: Persia
description: Land of the jinn.

name: Holy Land
description: Land of the jinn.

name: North Africa
description: Land of the jinn.

name: Babylon
description: Ancient source of astrology.

name: Underworld
description: Realm of the dead, where the Titans are imprisoned; a gateway believed beneath Etna.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The game setting.

name: Magic Realm
description: Realm of Magic where Daimons dwell and from which magical ghosts come.

name: Faerie Realm
description: Realm of faeries; many gods and some jinn and ghosts belong to it.

name: Infernal Realm
description: Realm of demons; some jinn and ghosts are Infernal.

name: Divine Realm
description: Divine realm; everything beyond the fixed stars is purely Divine.

name: Jar of Pandora
description: Jar that imprisoned the lugra; sought to bind them.

name: Rhinegold
description: Rumored treasure lying at the bottom of the Rhine.

name: Looking Glass of Intellego Vis
description: Glass of vis letting one see through a wall into a room.

name: Icicle of Perdo Vis
description: Never-melting icicle of vis that drains Fatigue.

name: Dust Devil of Auram Vis
description: Small whirlwind of vis keeping air breathable.

name: Mistletoe Sprig of Herbam Vis
description: Mistletoe vis granting understanding of its forest.

name: Ball of Light Ignem Vis
description: Glowing ball of vis providing illumination.

name: Laughter of Mentem Vis
description: Vis whose laughter fills listeners with joy.

name: Brimstone of Vim Vis
description: Brimstone vis that inflicts a Warping Point on contact.

name: Seed of Creo Vis
description: Seed of vis that grows instantly into a fruit tree.

name: Ash Branch of Muto Vis
description: Ash-branch vis granting Reserves of Strength and Toughness in battle.

name: Rosemary Sprig of Rego Vis
description: Rosemary vis protecting a home from weak wood faeries.

name: Egg of Animal Vis
description: Snake egg of vis that releases poisonous snakes when warmed.

name: Drop of Spring Water of Aquam Vis
description: Drop of vis creating a spring on bare earth.

name: Yarrow of Corpus Vis
description: Yarrow vis (soldier's wort) that heals wounds completely.

name: Crystal of Imaginem Vis
description: Rock crystal vis granting invisibility as Veil of Invisibility.

name: Silver Coin of Terram Vis
description: Faerie's coin of vis turning a thief to stone.

name: Container for Ephemeral Vis
description: Enchanted seashell or crystal to capture and release insubstantial vis.

name: Centaury of Virtue
description: Herb of Virtue granting witches flight when Enriched.

name: Cinquefoil of Virtue
description: Herb of Virtue granting eloquence and the Inspirational Virtue.

name: Fennel of Virtue
description: Herb of Virtue with 2 pawns of Vim vis, Enriched on St. Michael's day.

name: Periwinkle of Virtue
description: Herb granting Venus's Blessing as a love charm.

name: Vervain of Virtue
description: Herb granting Enduring Constitution.

name: Heart's Ease of Virtue
description: Herb granting Lesser Purifying Touch: Childbirth Fever.

name: Topaz of Virtue
description: Gem granting Inspirational or Puissant Leadership.

name: Sapphire of Virtue
description: Gem granting Intuition.

name: Stone Tell of the Mind That Sits
description: Spell to talk to a physical object, usable to speak with its Airy Spirit.

name: Stench of Twenty Corpses
description: Spell a spirit of rotting smell might duplicate.

name: Wizard's Communion
description: Spell used to boost Penetration for Daimon summoning.

name: Perceive the Firewalker
description: InIg 30 spell revealing creatures with Ignem-aligned Might.

name: Clenching Grasp of the Crushed Heart
description: Spell mirrored by the Leti's Touch of Death.

name: Sense the Nature of Vis
description: Spell revealing vis' nature and extraordinary powers.

name: Frosty Breath of the Spoken Lie
description: Lie-detecting spell.

name: Gift of Bear's Fortitude
description: Spell used in the Ash Branch of Muto Vis effect.

name: Veil of Invisibility
description: Invisibility spell duplicated by the Crystal of Imaginem Vis.

name: The Silent Vigil
description: Spell turning a person to stone.

name: Shell of False Determination
description: Vim spell effect caused by stored Vim vis.

name: The Phantom Gift
description: Vim effect creatures suffer near large Vim vis stores.

name: Magic Spirit
description: Special Virtue for spirits; all ghosts must have it.

name: Daimon (Virtue)
description: Free Social Status Virtue of all Daimons.

name: Ways of the (Land)
description: Virtue all genii loci possess, e.g. Ways of the Mountains, Deserts, Lakes, Caves.

name: Spiritual Pact
description: Virtue from a major bargain with a spirit.

name: Puissant (Ability)
description: Virtue boosting an Ability, e.g. Puissant Swim, Single Weapon, Leadership.

name: Great Communication
description: Characteristic Virtue.

name: Improved Characteristics
description: Virtue raising Characteristics.

name: Sharp Ears
description: Perception Virtue of the Zwergenstimme.

name: Self-Confident
description: Virtue of extra Confidence.

name: Great Perception
description: Characteristic Virtue.

name: Dowsing
description: Virtue to find hidden water, gained by Ismail from Warping.

name: Magical Champion
description: Social Status Virtue for ghosts.

name: Magical Covenfolk
description: Social Status for ghosts.

name: Magical Master
description: Social Status for ghosts.

name: Magical Monster
description: Social Status for ghosts, e.g. Sir Giles.

name: Magical Friend
description: Social Status for ghosts.

name: Knight
description: Social Status of Sir Giles.

name: Reserves of Strength
description: Virtue granted by Ash Branch vis.

name: Toughness
description: Virtue granted by Ash Branch vis.

name: Venus's Blessing
description: Virtue from Periwinkle of Virtue.

name: Enduring Constitution
description: Virtue from Vervain of Virtue.

name: Lesser Purifying Touch
description: Virtue from Heart's Ease of Virtue.

name: Inspirational
description: Virtue from Topaz or Cinquefoil of Virtue.

name: Intuition
description: Virtue from Sapphire of Virtue.

name: Greater Immunity
description: Virtue conferrable by a Herb of Virtue.

name: Affinity
description: Experience Virtue that Things of Virtue cannot confer.

name: Meddler
description: Flaw of the Spirit of Self-Importance.

name: Fury
description: Flaw of Adranus.

name: Wrathful
description: Personality Flaw granted by Adranus.

name: Visions
description: Flaw of prophetic dreams, held by Maria.

name: Simple-Minded
description: Flaw granted by Adranus; held by Aillwee.

name: Greedy
description: Flaw of al-Meraya.

name: Supernatural Nuisance
description: Flaw of Brienz.

name: Reclusive
description: Flaw of Brienz.

name: Compulsion
description: Flaw of Aillwee.

name: Human Ally
description: Flaw of Aillwee.

name: No Sense of Direction
description: Flaw granted by Aillwee.

name: Greater Malediction
description: Major Flaw binding jinn to bargains; granted by Rhenus as curse.

name: Mistaken Identity
description: Flaw of a magus who generated a self-importance eidolon.

name: Proud
description: Major Flaw of Sir Giles.

name: Baneful Circumstances
description: Flaw of Sir Giles (during the day).

name: Oath of Fealty
description: Flaw released by death.

name: Fragile Constitution
description: Physical Flaw irrelevant to ghosts.

name: Restriction
description: Hermetic Flaw applicable to Thing of Virtue powers.

name: Necessary Condition
description: Hermetic Flaw, e.g. intoxication for Centaury flight.

name: Magic Lore
description: Ability covering knowledge of magical things; needed to Enrich Things of Virtue.

name: Faerie Lore
description: Ability appearing in spirit statistics or rules in this text.

name: (Realm) Lore
description: Ability appearing in spirit statistics or rules in this text.

name: Second Sight
description: Ability to see spirits and invisible beings.

name: Charm
description: Ability appearing in spirit statistics or rules in this text.

name: Area Lore
description: Ability appearing in spirit statistics or rules in this text.

name: Swim
description: Ability appearing in spirit statistics or rules in this text.

name: Awareness
description: Ability appearing in spirit statistics or rules in this text.

name: Folk Ken
description: Ability appearing in spirit statistics or rules in this text.

name: Guile
description: Ability appearing in spirit statistics or rules in this text.

name: Music
description: Ability appearing in spirit statistics or rules in this text.

name: Thrown Weapon
description: Ability appearing in spirit statistics or rules in this text.

name: Carouse
description: Ability appearing in spirit statistics or rules in this text.

name: Etiquette
description: Ability appearing in spirit statistics or rules in this text.

description: Ability appearing in spirit statistics or rules in this text.

name: Leadership
description: Ability appearing in spirit statistics or rules in this text.

description: Ability appearing in spirit statistics or rules in this text.

name: Bargain
description: Ability appearing in spirit statistics or rules in this text.

description: Ability appearing in spirit statistics or rules in this text.

name: Magic Theory
description: Ability appearing in spirit statistics or rules in this text.

name: Concentration
description: Ability appearing in spirit statistics or rules in this text.

name: Animal Handling
description: Ability appearing in spirit statistics or rules in this text.

name: Athletics
description: Ability appearing in spirit statistics or rules in this text.

description: Ability appearing in spirit statistics or rules in this text.

description: Ability appearing in spirit statistics or rules in this text.

description: Ability appearing in spirit statistics or rules in this text.

description: Ability appearing in spirit statistics or rules in this text.

description: Ability appearing in spirit statistics or rules in this text.

description: Hermetic Art (Technique or Form) referenced in this text.

name: Intellego
